# Copilot instructions

Full agent instructions, commands and project status are in
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). This file repeats the essentials for Copilot
features that read only this file (for example code review). Keep both
consistent.

## Project

npm workspaces monorepo (Node 22, TypeScript, ESM):

- `packages/omp-usage`: Oh My Pi plugin. Writes usage metadata to JSONL only; no network.
- `packages/omp-usage-exporter`: imports JSONL into SQLite and serves Prometheus `/metrics` (esbuild bundle, CLI `omp-usage-exporter`).
- `packages/omp-usage-protocol`: private event schema, bundled into the exporter, never imported at runtime by a published package.
- `examples/grafana` (dashboards generated by `generate.py`), `examples/prometheus` (rules, alerts, promtool tests), `docs/` (MkDocs).

Validate with `npm run check`. Dashboards: edit `examples/grafana/generate.py`, then run it; never edit the JSON by hand.

## Review checklist

- OMP event names must exist in the OMP extension docs (`message_end`, `session_shutdown`); never invented.
- Reported cost (from OMP) and equivalent cost (tokens × price) stay separate. Missing usage or a missing price is never treated as zero.
- No router alias is mapped to a guessed model (`openrouter/free` stays as is). No price is applied to a different model.
- Reasoning tokens are not added to output again; `totalTokens` is not added to direction counters.
- OMP metrics and llama.cpp metrics (`llamacpp:*`) are never summed.
- No high-cardinality Prometheus labels (event id, session id, timestamps, paths, prompts).
- Plugin records no prompts, responses, tool input/output, keys or headers.
- Exporter: import, aggregates and cursor in one transaction; restarts never double count; one exporter per database.
- Files opened once and checked with `fstat` on the descriptor (no check-then-read).
- No private IP addresses outside example configs. Default listen `127.0.0.1:9464`.
- GitHub Actions pinned by commit SHA with version comment, minimal `permissions`, `persist-credentials: false`.
- Behaviour changes come with tests (integration tests for processes, files, signals) and updated `docs/`.
- PR titles are Conventional Commits; `!` / `BREAKING CHANGE` only for real breaking changes, because the squash commit drives release-please. PRs are based on `main`, not stacked.
- English for code, comments, docs and commit messages.
